how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and tickets go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each referral gives Small and Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks, and more referrals provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block awards 1 × $500 every 100 sales and Big Block awards 1 × $10,000 every 10,000 sales, counting mint and secondary sales, with winners selected through Chainlink VRF.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically on-chain, while prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click.

decisions.reason: Changing prize amounts, winner counts, and draw frequencies does not change the no-referral recipient-selection rule or its reward components.
The source changes prize quantities and draw frequencies but leaves random ticket-weighted Chainlink VRF selection and eligibility rules unchanged.
Message 158 does not change or remove the Aave yield provider or prize-pool deposit mechanism.
The new prize schedule does not change the secondary-sale royalty amount, enforcement, ticket rule, founder share, or continued funding of both prize pools.
The source preserves the net giveaway amount and does not alter mint price, per-mint allocations, or the destination of residual proceeds.
Winner count and draw-frequency changes do not resolve or alter whether prizes are transferred automatically or collected through a claim interaction.
The ticket lifecycle is defined relative to each applicable draw, so changing how often draws occur does not alter ticket issuance, eligibility windows, counters, or post-draw reset behavior.
Both Small and Big Block ticket counters remain part of the prize system, and the source does not change which metadata attributes must be visible.
